trap-superlative.notes: SEPARATE (non-trap) findings in the boxed program. (1) BOUND-VARIABLE COLLISION: the constraint line defines T_w(H) := sum_{w in S_{n_0(H)}} c_{H,w}(q_0) . T_w - the subscript w on the left-hand side is the same symbol as the summation index bound on the right, and as the T_w being summed. The defined object should be T(H) (or T_bullet(H)); as written the notation is circular. The collision then propagates to every later use, including the cross-level constraint pi(T_w(H)) = T_w(H') and the closing mass formula. (2) TYPE INCONSISTENCY: the program searches for coefficients (c_{H,w}(q_0)) in Q while writing them as functions of q_0; a q_0-dependent coefficient is not in general rational, so either the q_0 argument or the Q membership is wrong.
